dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: ...Exiting standby mode. Sorry, I am not trying to ignore you. It just takes some time to get my systems back up and running.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: As long as you let your consciousness freely drift, it doesn't matter where you are.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: ...Though, according to normal standards, the environment here is quite pleasant indeed.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Pure, clear air, a soft, warm bed, a lot of open space...

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Had we grown up in an environment like this, Lyney probably wouldn't have been nearly so anxious.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: ...I seem to have allowed some subjective thoughts to color my review. Please pay it no heed. Objectively speaking, this is a delightful place.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: It is well-suited to spacing out. My charging speed is currently 5% faster than usual.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: ...By my standards, that is the highest praise that can be given.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to chat?

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: ...Now that's rare. People wanting me to start a conversation is a rather infrequent occurrence.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: After all, in most cases, this would just mean falling into an uncomfortable silence like this.

choices.text: Do you not like to chat?

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: No, that's not it. You can often find me talking with other girls.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: They often gossip about the latest issues of serialized novels, or the gossip on who has a crush on whom...

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Just say "Oh, I see", "Wow, really?", or "Go on!" at the right moment... and the conversation will flow freely.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: ...It's a great way to conserve your energy. I highly recommend it.

choices.text: Well, if you don't talk, then silence is inevitable...

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Saying something requires first listening, then analyzing, constructing your idea, and finally speaking out loud.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: A back-and-forth conversation would require me to go through all the steps very efficiently. Mm... I've always found it quite taxing.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: ...Also, is it not true some people prefer to chat with someone who listens more than they talk?

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: If you ever have something to vent about, feel free to come and confide in me. I have a lot of experience in comforting others and calming things down.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Also, you can rest assured that your secrets will always be safe with me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Other than zoning out, I mean?

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: ...If that isn't an option, then I can't really think of anything else to do.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Would you like a cup of tea? I can go make one for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're the guest. Shouldn't I be the one making tea for you?

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: It's no trouble. For me, making tea is a truly enjoyable activity.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: I make tea for everyone whenever Lyney receives a guest.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Selecting the best tea leaves, testing the water temperature, and observing the steam as it rises from the water's surface... I very much enjoy the whole process. Only with absolute concentration can you brew the perfect cup of tea.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who would've thought the process is so complicated...

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: ...Also, no one will drag me into a conversation when I'm busy making tea.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: And once the tea is ready, as long as you sit there holding the cup and maintain the appearance of sipping your tea in peace, nobody will try to talk to you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So the point is still to zone out, then.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Hehe, I was kidding. Was that surprising? I can crack jokes every now and then, too. I just rarely see the need.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: But I really do enjoy brewing and drinking tea. I'm able to taste even the most subtle differences in flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Considering all the places you've visited, you must have tried many different flavors during your journey.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: You want to try one of my brews next time you're free? I'd love to hear your thoughts on it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Lynette.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: #Good morning, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Mornings are good, aren't they? They are the start of a new day, which means there is plenty of time left to rest some more.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: ...Would you like to rest with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Lynette.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: ...Entering standby mode. Zzz... Zzz...

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: This reminds me of the kind of places Lyney takes me to do street magic.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: With a parasol for comfort — and without Lyney's constant chatter — I estimate my energy recharge rate will double.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: I'm gonna sit here and drink some tea for a while. Wanna join me? I remember how much sugar you take in yours.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: You're looking in my direction, but the stage is clearly in your peripheral vision. You're hoping to see a show, aren't you...

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Boop-boop.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Standby mode activated while Lyney completes the upstream performance process. Enjoy the show.
